chunks: By Allah, your city would certainly be drowned so much so that as though I see its mosque like the upper part of a boat or a sitting ostrich.

key_terms.جُؤْجُؤِ سَفِينَةٍ: The prow/upper part of a ship

ai.seo_question: What is the prophecy regarding the flooding of Basra in Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (AS) delivers this vivid prophecy regarding the geographical fate of Basra, a city he had previously fortified and named 'Al-Madinah' (the City). The comparison of the submerged mosque to a ship's prow or a sitting ostrich underscores the specific topographical vulnerability of the region to flooding, reflecting the historical reality of the Tigris and Euphrates river systems. This narration is often cited by Shia scholars as an example of the Imam's insight into the physical and spiritual conditions of the cities under his governance.
